fact: UNESCO's readiness assessment of Angola lists formal approval of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy as a next step, so the strategy exists but is not yet approved; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

UNESCO's assessment lists establishing a dedicated interinstitutional coordination mechanism for AI as a next step, so no such body existed; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.

MINTTICS national director Hecdiantro Mena said at the second National AI Forum that the National Artificial Intelligence Plan is in public consultation and will be the country's main strategic guide on AI.

The Administrative Modernisation Institute (IMA) said it is preparing a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy for public services, built on technological sovereignty, interoperability, public data and national talent.
